titulo: What Happens to Wasps When Winter Comes?
titulos_alternativos: Where Do Wasps Go in Winter? (One Might Be in Your Attic)
Never Kill the Sleepy Wasp in Your Attic. Here's Why
descripcion:
Every autumn, a wasp nest with thousands of wasps goes completely silent. They don't fly south and they don't hibernate together. So where do they all go? The answer is stranger than you think, and one of them might be sleeping inside your house right now.

In this video: why wasps crash your picnic in September, why almost the entire colony dies with the first frosts, how one young queen survives half a year without eating, and how a single sleepy insect in your attic becomes a city of thousands by midsummer.
